purpose: Labeled related/unrelated topic pairs for the Task 3.3 local semantic-linkage spike (tmp/spikes/topic_family_embeddings.py). Contexts simulate a bounded related-query + root-post text window per topic. Contexts deliberately avoid leaking the paired topic's distinctive vocabulary so that lexical methods cannot shortcut semantically related pairs.
pairing_rule: related=true means the two topics should end up in the same topic family or connected by an allowed relationship (alias/broader/narrower/enabling_technology/alternative/associated_event/related_distinct). related=false means clearly distinct families.

x402.label: x402
x402.context: Coinbase AP2 turns the HTTP 402 Payment Required status into a working micropayment rail. Requests attach USDC wrapped in payment headers; middleware intercepts 402 responses, pays and retries. Builders discuss replacing API keys with pay-per-request metering.

agentic_payments.label: agentic payments
agentic_payments.context: AI agents that transact on their own: a wallet provisioned per session, machine-to-machine settlement, budgets and spend limits enforced in code. Debate over per-call billing for tool endpoints and whether human approval should gate every charge.

stablecoin_payments.label: stablecoin payments
stablecoin_payments.context: Treasury teams settle invoices in USDC instead of waiting on correspondent banks. Cross-border remittance over on-chain rails, near-instant finality, finance threads on treasury policy and reconciliation headaches.

mcp_servers.label: MCP servers
mcp_servers.context: Model Context Protocol servers expose databases, browsers and filesystems to LLM applications through a standard tool interface. Community registries list third-party servers; teams argue about sandboxing and auth scopes.

function_calling.label: function calling
function_calling.context: Structured tool use for LLM APIs: arguments validated against JSON schemas, parallel invocations, streaming partial results. Portability complaints across providers; wrappers that normalize request shapes.

claude_code.label: Claude Code
claude_code.context: Terminal-native coding assistant: subagents spawned per task, context window budgeting, hooks and plugins. Threads on unattended overnight refactor runs and reviewing the diff in the morning.

glp1.label: GLP-1
glp1.context: GLP-1 receptor agonist injections dominate obesity treatment forums. Titration schedules, nausea management, compounding pharmacy shortages after demand spikes, staying on versus cycling off.

ozempic.label: Ozempic
ozempic.context: Semaglutide weekly pen. Insurance denial threads, coupon hunting before refills, restaurant portions suddenly uneaten, hair thinning anecdotes. Shortage of the starter dose pushing users toward alternatives.

tirzepatide.label: tirzepatide
tirzepatide.context: Dual GIP/GLP-1 agonist with higher headline weight loss. Users switching from semaglutide report fewer cravings, GI side effects and plateau fears; gray-market peptide sourcing warnings.

nofap.label: nofap
nofap.context: Abstinence challenge communities count streaks, log relapses and trade motivation framing. Self-improvement language around energy, confidence and discipline. Success-story threads and flatline anxiety posts.

dopamine_detox.label: dopamine detox
dopamine_detox.context: Cutting short-form video, porn and endless scrolling to reset a fried reward system. Cold-turkey diaries, screen-time screenshot flexes, replacement habits like lifting and reading.

rtx_5090.label: RTX 5090
rtx_5090.context: Nvidia Blackwell flagship launch. Scalper bots, the gap between MSRP and street price, 575W power connector worries, stock-drop Discord trackers, returned-unit horror stories.

gpu_shortage.label: GPU shortage
gpu_shortage.context: AI datacenter demand eats consumer card supply. Memory allocation favors hyperscalers, board partners raise prices, the shortage extends to previous-gen cards, used-market listings spike.

sleep_maxing.label: sleep maxing
sleep_maxing.context: Optimized bedtime stack: mouth tape, magnesium glycinate, blackout curtains, cold room, consistent wake time. Daily readiness scores posted from wearables; debate over which gadgets move the needle.

oura_ring.label: Oura ring
oura_ring.context: Finger wearable tracking sleep stages, HRV and temperature trends. Firmware update complaints, subscription pricing gripes, comparisons against chest straps and smartwatch sleep estimates.

pairs.note: Canonical lexically-dissimilar pair required by plan Task 3.3; contexts share no distinctive keyword.
Both crypto/tech adjacent; no semantic bridge.
Lexical trap: the word 'shortage' appears in both contexts.
